description.zh: Secret实例所在命名空间ID。如果所在命名空间为默认命名空间，则只需填写RegionId，例如`cn-beijing`。
description.en: The ID of the namespace. If the secret is in the default namespace, you need to specify only the region ID, for example, `cn-beijing`.

description.zh: 需要删除的Secret实例ID。需要调用[ListSecrets](~~466929~~)接口查看。
description.en: The ID of the secret to delete. You can obtain the ID by calling the [ListSecrets](~~466929~~) operation.
